[SWS_DM_01346] Handling negative return values of
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04279
⌈
If
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::ExecuteReset
returns any of the defined
error codes in [SWS_DM_01014], the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall return
a Negative Response with NRC equal to the returned error code, if a final response to
the request was not sent yet.
⌋
